name: Vidit Singh Chauhan
headline: I build Kubernetes-native infrastructure and cost-efficient observability.
about: DevOps Engineer at Qpaix Infitech, where I went from intern to full-time by owning production infrastructure: k3s clusters and observability across multiple production servers, CI/CD pipelines for 55+ applications, and deployments for Gujarat Government projects.
Most interested in Kubernetes-native platforms, GitOps and observability stacks that don't cost a fortune.
